summary: @or-sdk/invitations preinstall downloads Bun runtime to execute a heavily obfuscated bundled payload
details: package.json declares `preinstall: node setup.mjs`. setup.mjs is itself obfuscated (hex-named identifiers, indirection objects) and, on `npm install`, downloads the Bun runtime archive from `https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v<version>/<platform>.zip`, extracts the `bun` binary to a temp directory, chmods it executable, and invokes it via execFileSync against a bundled sibling file `math_init.js`. math_init.js is a ~727KB blob using the obfuscator.io string-array + rotation pattern (a giant mixed string/number array shifted by a rotator function, all identifiers renamed to hex forms), whose behavior is not derivable from the code and bears no relation to any invitations/SDK functionality. Using an alternate language runtime to execute an opaque install-time payload sidesteps Node-based scanners; the preinstall launcher's own obfuscation and the payload's cover-name (`math_init.js`) are further evasion signals. Installing this package auto-executes attacker-controlled, unreviewable code on the installer's machine.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
